title: Rob SV Battler with Vibrato Art style

posts.author: KatanaProductions
posts.body:
So right now I'm developing a game that uses characters from the MV Cover Art Character Pack:
And the side view battler that I'm using is from Vibrato08 :
SV Battler | P3X-774
vibrato08.wixsite.com
Vibrato-san has all of the custom battlers from the Cover Art Character Pack except for Rob. And here I'm looking for an artist who is willing to make/edit SV Battler of Rob in Vibrato's art style.
Resource Type:
Side View Battler
Maker Format:
RPG Maker MV
Makers I Own:
RPG Maker MV, RPG Maker MZ, RPG Maker XP
Art Style:
Vibrato08's Artstyle (196 x 128)
Description:
I think I'm not going too specific about the request because I don't want to make it more difficult for the artist. But, just in case someone needs direction, what I see from Rob's picture is that he is a strong character who can lift a boulder.
(Optional description that doesn't have to be followed) : In my game, Rob can detach from his body and become a fairy. And Sophie the fairy can even sit in Rob's body haha.
BTW, This sprite was made by Tonbi-san:
http://tonbi.jp/Game/RPGMakerDLC/index_e.html
Reference Images:
This is what I found on Vibrato's Pixiv. Maybe it can be used as a starting point.
Source :
First Rob Image:
http://tkool.jp/mv/
Second Picture:
https://wallpapercave.com/w/wp11914150
Third: From Cover Art Character Pack DLC
Last one:
https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/51976965
And just in case you want to see how the SV Battler going to be used here is my game (in development):
MV - RTP Project (First Cutscene Demo Available)
RTP Project The title of the game is not decided yet :v   DISCLAIMER This game is still very early in development and the content inside it is still subject to change. Battle is still not available in this demo.  SECTION A: SYNOPSIS   IMAGES/SCREENSHOTS   SECTION B: CHARACTERS   DOWNLOAD LINK
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Thank you very much for visiting this page. And I hope I didn't break any rules.

posts.body: Hi there, are we sure that piece is permitted for use and/or modification? I have not seen it in any asset pack that Vibrato has distributed, and it’s not listed in p3x-774 site either.

Material | P3X-774
vibrato08.wixsite.com
I read the ToU once again. From what I understand,
- The Rob image is from Vibrato Pixiv and not Gallery Corner.
- "Secondary distribution of individual materials is prohibited. If you want to refer to it in the community such as bulletin boards, please refer to the HP address of this site."
I am assuming this means reposting the SV Battler Material from his/her website is prohibited and rather link back to the website. If anyone corrects me that posting Rob Battler from Pixiv is against this term I will remove it from my original post and just leave the link.
- Vibrato allows the material to be modified and some people already made an edit of it and some are taken from Vibrato Pixiv so I think it is permitted.

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
KatanaProductions said:
so I think it is permitted.
Click to expand...
And this is exactly how rips become rampant. If it’s not clearly written, then the assumption should be that it is not permitted.
I don’t see anywhere on his Pixiv that redistribution or modification is permitted, and AFAIK Pixiv is the only site where this particular image is showcased. That “other people” have also taken things from Vibrato’s Pixiv does not validate doing this.
I’ll check with him, please wait.
